# Do we qualify for Marriage Allowance, and what can we claim back?

> Free UK Marriage Allowance calculator for 2025/26 and 2026/27: enter both partners' incomes to see if you qualify, how much tax you save (up to £252 a year) and what a four-year backdated claim is worth. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
